title: Fleet Health + Capacity-Aware Workers UI
intent: Surface backend worker telemetry and pressure assessment in the web UI so operators can see fleet capacity, filter by pressure state, request cleanup, and preview ML placement with resource-pressure-aware ranking.
observed_inputs: Worker JSON includes telemetry and pressure objects from backend event content.
Workers page already reads worker objects from web stores and publishes worker commands through publishCommand.
ML preview computes local eligibility scores in web/src/routes/ml/page-model.js.
